name: Fresh solo dungeon route to key corpse

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.05

at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage
at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetDead

local self=require('openmw.self')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local ready,east,facing,close=false,false,false,false
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not ready then ready=true print('Sewer Player frame ready') end
 if not east and self.position.x>1930 then east=true print('Sewer east lane '..tostring(self.position)) end
 local dx,dy=2003.264-self.position.x,3034.733-self.position.y
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local angle=math.atan2(f.y*dx-f.x*dy,f.x*dx+f.y*dy)
 if east and not facing and math.abs(angle)<.04 then facing=true print('Sewer facing key corpse') end
 if not close and math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<100 then close=true print('Sewer key corpse in range '..tostring(self.position)) end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer>.2 then timer=0 print('Sewer approach '..tostring(self.position)..' angle '..angle) end
end}}}}
